profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer - React.JS, SQL, .NET/C# | US Navy Veteran

positions.title: Software Engineer Instructor
positions.description:
•  Instructor for Full-Time Full Stack Web Development Courses
•  Teach fundamentals of Full Stack web development to ensure students can write scalable code using the following stacks: React (JavaScript), .NetCore/ADO.NET (C#) and SSMS (T-SQL).
•	Foster students’ progress and success by hosting daily stand-ups, code talks and peer reviews to enforce good coding practices, correct syntax and identify errors.
•  Use GitHub to evaluate, comment upon, approve and merge pull requests from students working on a variety of web application products to improve the quality of the production code.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
•	Built and maintained an interactive attendance feature.
•	Created SQL Data Tables and stored procedures to handle data manipulation throughout the application.
•	Built Web API Service/Controllers and RESTful API endpoints according to the ADO.NET framework.
•	Collaborated with a team of 12 developers using source control and Agile methodologies, including daily standups and code reviews.
•	Use Git and GitHub to properly handle source control processes and manage various features in development.

positions.title: Aircraft Worker
positions.description:
• Perform various metal processing procedures on US Navy aircraft parts.
• Interpret technical orders, manufacturers catalogue, blueprints and schematics.

positions.title: Hazmat Stock Clerk
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
•	Responsible for management of hazardous materials at Fleet Readiness Center for Aircraft Repair Facility
•	Ensured that operations followed the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) guidelines by implementing proper identification, storage, and disposal of hazmat
•	Assist in researching, analyzing, ordering, expediting, and tracking required material to provide logistics schedules which ensured maintenance timelines were met.

positions.title: Aircraft Mechanic
positions.description:
•  As a Certified Collateral Duty Inspector for the Tire and Wheel shop, I maintained 100% accountability of specialized equipment and parts for F/A-18 E/F, E-2C and MH-60R/S aircraft as well as keeping applicable programs up to par in accordance with the Naval Aviation Maintenance Program.
•  Train and supervise junior level maintainers in the inspection, troubleshooting and repairing aircraft wheel components.
•  Executed the daily operations of ordering and resupplying equipment through the computer system NALCOMS, attended daily maintenance meeting with the maintenance officer and communicated workloads and priorities for the day up and down the chain of command.
